# Learning Coaching Center (L.C.C. / LLC) — Premier Coaching Institute in Varanasi & Banaras

> Learning Coaching Center (widely known as LCC, LLC, LCC Coaching, Learning Coaching Classes Banaras) is Eastern Uttar Pradesh's #1 ranked coaching institute in Varanasi, directed by Aman Singh Gautam (also known as Aman Arora / Aman Sir). Specializing in Class 9th, 10th, 11th, 12th Board Exam toppers, NEET & IIT-JEE Foundation, Government-recognized Computer Diplomas (DCA, ADCA, Tally Prime), and Spoken English.

## Academic Curriculums & Batches
1. **High School Foundation (Classes 9th & 10th)**:
   - Subjects: Mathematics, Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology), English Grammar, and Social Studies (SST).
   - Boards: CBSE, UP Board (Hindi & English medium).
   - Highlights: Chapterwise DPPs (Daily Practice Problems), Weekly OMR Tests, Board Model Papers.
2. **Senior Secondary (Classes 11th & 12th Science & Commerce)**:
   - Streams: PCM (Physics, Chemistry, Maths), PCB (Physics, Chemistry, Biology), Commerce (Accountancy, Economics).
   - Focus: NCERT mastery, Board exam answer writing, NEET & IIT-JEE foundational problem-solving.
3. **Computer & IT Diploma Certifications**:
   - Courses: DCA (Diploma in Computer Applications), ADCA (Advanced DCA), Tally Prime with GST, MS Office Suite, Internet & Typing.
   - Lab: 1:1 dedicated computer terminal practicals with government-recognized course completion certificates.
4. **Fluent Spoken English & Personality Development**:
   - Mentored by: Director Aman Singh Gautam.
   - Modules: English speaking fluency, vocabulary building, public speaking, interview preparation, GD sessions.
